newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-TB SCARE AT SCOTTISH CLUB.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TB SCARE AT SCOTTISH CLUB.

text.p: Scottish premier division club Kilmarnock are to screen all their players and staff after defender Neil Whitworth was diagnosed as suffering from tuberculosis.
Englishman Whitworth, 24, was taken to hospital on Wednesday, manager Alex Totten said on Saturday.
"It was only last night that I was told he had TB," Totten said. "It is a tragedy for the lad as he has been a tremendous signing for me."
Whitworth signed for Kilmarnock from Manchester United in 1994 and has collected several player-of-the year awards in Scotland.
